svg.title: Causal mask: fixed scores, masked logits and exact row softmax
svg.desc: Rows are queries and columns are keys. Key j is allowed when j is at most the query index i. Future logits become negative infinity before softmax and their weights are exactly zero. The second row has weights approximately 0.130,0.870,0,0,0.
svg.text: Rows: Query i · Columns: Key j · Allow j ≤ i, including the current token
All 25 input scores are shown unchanged.
The diagonal and all earlier keys are allowed.
Future weights = 0 exactly; each row sums to 1.
Fixed illustrative scores; Decimal probabilities are displayed to 3 decimals. Row sums are 1 before rounding.
Row i reads only keys 1…i. Blocking happens before softmax; future scores never enter its denominator.
